posts.author: ShadowfireOmega
posts.body: I made a 96x144 terrain png and added it to the game. Each 48x48 'tile' is fully able to continue on to any other of the five tiles (or itself) indefinitely (aka six 'tiles' with identical edges). However when I use them in MZ, it just repeats upon itself. Is there any way to randomize which of the six tiles is placed for each square?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
autotiles do NOT work with full 48x48 tile sequences, they are constructed from 24x24 pixel quartertiles.
and the selection of which quartertiles are used for any part of the map depends on the surrounding tiles and is fixed.
so no, you can't expect a randomization on that level - you either have to place random tiles manually or request a plugin for changing the way autotiles work - which will not be easy due to the many requirements for autotiles.
